TYPES.Item.chassis: Ancestry, Bloodline, Culture, Background or Calling
STARWROUGHT.Sheet.applyHint: Spend this damage on the selected or targeted tokens.
STARWROUGHT.Sheet.noConstellations: Nothing invested in yet. Drag a Talent onto the sheet and its Constellation opens itself.
STARWROUGHT.Sheet.rootOnly: No line in: needs only the Root.
STARWROUGHT.Sheet.spentHint: 0 Vigor. Every Hit that lands Wounds the Zone it strikes; a Critical Hit inflicts two. Grazes never Wound.
STARWROUGHT.Defense.awarenessHint: Don't be surprised. Answers Blights and Beguilement.
STARWROUGHT.Defense.evadeHint: Don't be there. Answers Blows and Blasts.
STARWROUGHT.Defense.guardHint: Don't let it through. Answers Blows and Beguilement; a ranged Blow only with a shield Raised.
STARWROUGHT.Defense.endureHint: Survive what does come through. Answers Blasts and Blights.
STARWROUGHT.Defense.untrainedHint: Untrained: the Attribute still counts, but every Threshold that depends on this Defense is 3 lower.
STARWROUGHT.Threat.label: Threat
STARWROUGHT.Threat.blowHint: Steel, fists, arrows, falls. Answered by Evade or Guard; Guard answers a ranged Blow only with a shield Raised.
STARWROUGHT.Threat.blastHint: Fire, cold, thunder, a wall of force. Answered by Evade or Endure.
STARWROUGHT.Threat.blightHint: Poison, disease, exhaustion, anything trying to break your body. Answered by Endure or Awareness.
STARWROUGHT.Threat.beguilementHint: Lies, fear, charm, the trick you did not see coming. Answered by Awareness or Guard.
STARWROUGHT.Strike.quickHint: Quick Strike ❶: a probe. One weapon die and any precision damage, nothing else. It cannot Critically Hit unless the weapon is Agile (a natural 20 is a Hit), Protection applies in full even on an Exposed Zone, and it lands on the Torso. Stopped, it costs you nothing.
STARWROUGHT.Strike.deliberateHint: Deliberate Strike ❷: all your dice, specialization and Might. It may be placed on an Exposed Zone, and a Critical Hit lets you Expose a plausible Zone. A Miss Exposes you in a Zone of the defender's choice; a Parry that Stops it takes Control.
STARWROUGHT.Strike.committedHint: Committed Strike ❸: Prepared, one action now and two reserved, resolved at your next Opportunity. All your dice, specialization and Might; on any Hit you may Expose a plausible Zone. Stopped at all, Graze or Miss, you are Exposed; a Parry that Stops it takes Control.
STARWROUGHT.Strike.prepared: {name} raises {weapon}: a Committed Strike ❸, Prepared. One action now, two reserved; it resolves at their next Opportunity.
STARWROUGHT.Strike.quickNoCrit: A Quick Strike cannot Critically Hit without Agile: the natural 20 is a Hit.
STARWROUGHT.Strike.exposeHint: The attacker is Exposed in a Zone of the defender's choice, until they Recenter.
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.label: Reaction
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.parryHint: ❶↺ Guard Training. Guard with a +2 Situation bonus; you need a rigid weapon, a shield or a permitted natural weapon in hand. Stop a Deliberate or Committed Strike and you take Control of the attacking weapon and may riposte with a Quick Strike ⓿. A Stopped Quick Strike gives only a neutral Bind.
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.voidHint: ❶↺ Evade Training. Evade with a +2 Situation bonus. If the attack is Stopped, you may Step in any direction.
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.counterHint: ❶↺ Melee Expert. Answer a melee Blow from a foe within your Reach with a Quick Strike of your own. No bonus to your Defense; roll both, resolve both.
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.interceptHint: ❶↺ Melee Training. When a foe Moves from outside your Total Reach to inside it, or Strikes you with an Unwieldy weapon from inside its Unwieldy distance, make a Quick Strike as they enter. Once per foe per Move. A Wound stops their movement; anything less and it continues.
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.postureHint: ⓿↺ A Talent's Situation bonus to one Defense. It always Exposes a Zone until the end of the round, and Recenter does not clear that one.
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.needsRigid: Parry needs a rigid implement in hand: a weapon without the Flexible trait, or a shield. Nothing is prevented; the table decides.
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.never: A Reaction never triggers a Reaction.
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.interceptOffer: {mover} is entering {name}'s Total Reach. Intercept ❶↺ with a Quick Strike?
STARWROUGHT.Zone.head: Head
STARWROUGHT.ZoneCrit.head: Cannot use Reactions until it Recenters.
STARWROUGHT.ZoneCrit.arms: A −2 Situation penalty to attack rolls until it Recenters.
STARWROUGHT.ZoneCrit.exposedWound: The Zone was Exposed and the Strike was Deliberate or Committed: it is Wounded as well.
STARWROUGHT.Wound.title: Wound
STARWROUGHT.Wound.armsFirst: A −2 Situation penalty to attacks and to Guard.
STARWROUGHT.Wound.armsFinal: The arm is useless. Drop anything held in it; you cannot Guard, Bind, or attack with it.
STARWROUGHT.Wound.legsFinal: You fall Prone and cannot Stand.
STARWROUGHT.Wound.applied: {name} takes a Wound to the {zone} ({n} of {capacity}): {effect}
STARWROUGHT.Wound.appliedTwo: {name} takes two Wounds to the {zone}: a Critical Hit while Spent.
STARWROUGHT.Wound.redirected: The {zone} is already useless, so the Wound goes to the Torso.
STARWROUGHT.Wound.treatHint: Treat this Wound: ten minutes and an Endure check against 10 + the Wounds carried. On a success the Wound is bound: its effect ends, and it still counts as a Wound until it heals after a week of Downtime.
STARWROUGHT.Wound.treated: {name}'s {zone} Wound is bound. Its effect ends; it still counts until it heals.
STARWROUGHT.Wound.abandonsPrepared: The Wound interrupts what {name} was Preparing; it is abandoned.
STARWROUGHT.Damage.grazeMinimum: A Graze always does at least 1
STARWROUGHT.Action.recenterHint: Recenter ❶: clear every Exposed Zone on you (one Exposed by a Posture stays until the end of the round) and end any Bind you are in.
STARWROUGHT.Action.recenterText: {name} gathers up: every Exposed Zone closes, and any Bind ends.
STARWROUGHT.Action.raiseShieldHint: ❶ Raise or lower this shield. Raised, it is a rigid implement: it can Parry, Bind and Gain Control.
STARWROUGHT.Action.raiseShieldOn: {name} raises the {shield}: +{bonus} Gear bonus to Guard against physical Attacks until their next Opportunity.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.offGuardHint: A −2 Situation penalty to Evade and Guard against all foes.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.frightenedHint: −N to all checks and Thresholds; reduce by 1 at the end of each round.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.proneHint: Off-Guard, −2 to Attacks; +2 Situation to Evade against ranged Attacks. Stand ❶ to clear.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.grabbedHint: Off-Guard and cannot Move or Step; Escape ❶ to break free. Evade is unavailable.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.restrainedHint: As Grabbed, but you can take no action other than Escape ❶.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.heedlessHint: Commitment so complete that you have stopped thinking. Maneuvers with Concentrate cost 1 extra action.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.stunnedHint: Lose the next N actions; may carry over across rounds.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.slowedHint: Lose N actions at the start of each round. Reduce by 1 at the end of each round.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.fatiguedHint: −1 to Evade and Guard; cannot use Exploration Mode Activities.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.blindedHint: Cannot see or Observe any creature. Off-Guard.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.deafenedHint: Cannot hear. Immune to any Auditory Maneuver or Activity.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.unconsciousHint: Out, Dying or knocked cold: you drop everything you hold, and you are Prone.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.dyingHint: Unconscious and helpless. Dying counts up: damage adds 1 (2 from a Critical Hit); Dying 5 is death. A Recovery check at the start of each round.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.woundedHint: That Zone carries a Wound: its critical effect made lasting. Fill the Torso's or Head's capacity and you are Dying.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.spentHint: 0 Vigor. Every Hit that lands on you Wounds the Zone struck; a Critical Hit inflicts two. Grazes never Wound.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.boundHint: Your implement is in a neutral Bind with a foe's. It ends if either of you Moves, Steps or Recenters, or when a Strike between you resolves.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.controlledHint: A foe Controls your weapon: you have an Exposed Zone of their choice while the Bind lasts, and your attacks with that weapon take a −2 Situation penalty. Recenter ❶ or Step to end it.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.controllingHint: You Control a foe's weapon: they have an Exposed Zone of your choice, and you may Close ❶ on them. The Bind ends if a third party attacks you.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.preparingHint: A Maneuver of three or more actions begun: one spent, the rest reserved. You cannot Pass; finish or abandon it at your next Opportunity. Taking a Wound abandons it.
STARWROUGHT.Condition.exposedHint: Ordinary Hits can land on that Zone instead of your Torso, and a Deliberate or Committed Strike ignores its Protection. Recenter ❶ to clear, unless a Posture Exposed it: that lasts until the end of the round.
STARWROUGHT.Bind.label: The Bind
STARWROUGHT.Bind.controlling: Controlling {partner}'s {theirs} with {mine}: they have an Exposed Zone of your choice and −2 Situation with it, and you may Close ❶.
STARWROUGHT.Bind.controlled: Controlled by {partner}: their {theirs} on my {mine}. An Exposed Zone of their choice, −2 Situation with it, until the Bind ends.
STARWROUGHT.Bind.formHint: Guard Stopped the attack with a rigid implement: the two weapons are Bound, neutral.
STARWROUGHT.Bind.takeControlHint: A Parry Stopped a Deliberate or Committed Strike, or Guard answered a Miss: you Control the attacking weapon and open a Zone of your choice.
STARWROUGHT.Bind.controlTaken: {name} Controls {partner}'s {theirs}. {partner} is Exposed in a Zone of {name}'s choice while it lasts.
STARWROUGHT.Bind.endHint: The Bind ends: a Strike between you resolved, either of you Moved or Recentered, you were attacked by a third party, or the implement was dropped or Disarmed.
STARWROUGHT.Bind.closeHint: ❶ Step toward the foe whose weapon you Control. The Bind holds, and that weapon cannot Intercept you.
STARWROUGHT.Bind.samePartner: A Bind is between two fighters; this card names the same creature on both sides.
STARWROUGHT.Bind.notFormed: The Bind could not be formed. The console says why.
STARWROUGHT.Rules.openBind: Open the rules for the Bind
STARWROUGHT.Rules.where: The full rules are on the page "{page}" of the STARWROUGHT Reference journal, in the Rules Reference compendium.
STARWROUGHT.Rules.missing: The Rules Reference has no page named "{page}". Rebuild the compendia with node assets/build_foundry.mjs.
STARWROUGHT.Protection.quickOnExposed: Exposed, but a Quick Strike meets full Protection
STARWROUGHT.Section.heldHint: what you can Strike or Raise with
STARWROUGHT.Field.milestoneHint: Four Milestones make a level. The first three each grant a Milestone Talent Point, spent immediately in a Flared Constellation.
STARWROUGHT.Field.vigorHint: What you have left in you: wind, focus, luck. 10 + Ancestry Vigor + Calling Vigor at 1st level, and the same again every level after. At 0 you are Spent.
STARWROUGHT.Field.tempHint: Temporary Vigor is spent first, is not healing, and never stacks with a second pool: the larger replaces the smaller. Losing it does not make you Spent.
STARWROUGHT.Field.vigorPerLevelHint: Added to Vigor at 1st level and again at every level after. Only your first Calling counts.
STARWROUGHT.Field.heroPointsHint: Spend 1 to reroll a check. Spend all of them to refuse death.
STARWROUGHT.Field.woundedHint: Wounds are carried per Zone: each is that Zone's critical effect made lasting. Recenter does not clear one and neither does rest; treating it takes ten minutes and an Endure check, and it heals after a week of Downtime.
STARWROUGHT.Field.woundsHint: No Wounds. This Zone carries {capacity} before its final effect.
STARWROUGHT.Field.capacityHint: Medium or smaller 2, Large 3, Huge 4, Gargantuan 5. A creature template may add to it.
STARWROUGHT.Field.dyingHint: At Dying 5, you die. A Recovery check at the start of each round: Endure against 10 + Dying + the Wounds you carry.
STARWROUGHT.Field.pointsHint: Talent Points spent in this Constellation.
STARWROUGHT.Field.inheritedHint: A Combat Style's Talents count toward its parent's rank, Melee or Ranged. The parent's own Talents must still be bought, and Attribute Points are never counted twice.
STARWROUGHT.Field.nextRankHint: What the next Proficiency Rank is still waiting on.
STARWROUGHT.Field.thresholdHint: The number someone else has to beat: 10 + the same modifier the check rolls.
STARWROUGHT.Field.speedHint: Speed is how far one Move ❶ carries you, in feet. A Human's is 6.
STARWROUGHT.Field.stepHint: Step ❶: half your Speed. It never provokes an Intercept and cannot enter difficult terrain.
STARWROUGHT.Field.rushHint: Rush ❸: five times your Speed in a straight line, less your Load Strain in feet. No Reactions until your next Opportunity, and Off-Guard against any Intercept it provokes.
STARWROUGHT.Field.leapHint: Leap ❶: 10 feet across, less your Load Strain, or 3 feet up.
STARWROUGHT.Field.meleeHint: Melee Proficiency: every Strike with a weapon that stays in your hand rolls it. Your Combat Styles' Talents count toward its rank.
STARWROUGHT.Field.rangedHint: Ranged Proficiency: every Strike with a weapon that leaves your hand rolls it, a thrown dagger included. Your Combat Styles' Talents count toward its rank.
STARWROUGHT.Field.weaponDiceHint: How many weapon dice a Deliberate or Committed Strike rolls at your level: two at 4th, three at 8th, four at 12th, five at 16th. A Quick Strike and a Graze roll one.
STARWROUGHT.Field.actionsPerRoundHint: Six for almost everything. Some creatures have more or fewer.
STARWROUGHT.Field.loadStrainHint: Subtracted from Evade, and from any Might or Agility Skill check; Rush and Leap lose this many feet. Endure relieves it from Expert rank: 1 at Expert, 2 at Master, 3 at Legendary. From the end of the third round, a fighter carrying any of it rolls Endure against 10 + Load Strain each round or is Fatigued.
STARWROUGHT.Field.familiarityHint: Weapon Groups and Technical weapons you are Familiar with, from Weapon Familiarity.
STARWROUGHT.Field.flareHint: Flared. A Milestone Talent Point may be spent here.
STARWROUGHT.Field.rootHint: Root Talent. Buying it is what makes you Trained.
STARWROUGHT.Field.parentHint: Melee or Ranged. Every Talent bought in this Constellation also counts toward the parent's Proficiency Rank. Only rank is inherited: the parent's own Talents must still be bought, and Attribute Points are never counted twice.
STARWROUGHT.Field.costMaxHint: Some Maneuvers cost a range. Strike is one action to three (Quick ❶, Deliberate ❷, Committed ❸); Disarm is one or three, with nothing in between. Leave this blank when the cost is fixed.
STARWROUGHT.Field.reactionHint: Usable in answer to its Trigger, outside your Opportunity, at the listed cost. Paid from the same six actions; there is no separate reaction slot.
STARWROUGHT.Field.reactionCostHint: When the Reaction half costs something different from the Maneuver itself, as Aid ❶ (⓿↺) does. Leave it blank when the two are the same.
STARWROUGHT.Field.choiceHint: Some Talents ask you to pick something once, and mean nothing until you have. Weapon Familiarity is the one that matters most: without an answer here, nothing knows which Weapon Group you are Familiar with, and your Handling never improves.
STARWROUGHT.Field.freeTalentPlaceholder: A Talent granted outright, no point spent
STARWROUGHT.Field.styleHint: The slug of the Combat Style this weapon belongs to. If its wielder owns that Style's Root, the Style's Key Attribute may be the Strike Attribute.
STARWROUGHT.Field.basicHint: Listed on every character's Maneuvers tab while this Item lives in the compendium or the world. A copy on a character is that character's own.
STARWROUGHT.Field.totalReachHint: Natural Reach {natural} ft + weapon {weapon} ft = {total} ft, measured from the edge of your space to the edge of your target's.
STARWROUGHT.Field.rangeHint: A ranged weapon: this is its range, not your reach.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.thresholdWithheld: The Attack Threshold this roll meets is read on the attack card: an adversary's is the GM's to know, and the outcome is posted when the die lands.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.relevantIntro: A Relevant Check is yours to place. Choose the Constellation whose training applies and say why; the GM approves, and the card shows both.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.relevantWhyPlaceholder: steadying the ladder while she climbs
STARWROUGHT.Roll.relevantHint: Untrained is a real answer, not an error. The next dialog takes the situational modifier and the roll's visibility.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.relevantNpc: Adversaries do not roll Relevant Checks; they carry Thresholds.
STARWROUGHT.Sheet.relevantCheckHint: Roll a Relevant Check: you choose the Constellation, the GM approves. Shift-click to skip the modifier dialog.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.strikeHint: Strike with this weapon: a Deliberate Strike ❷ unless you pick another. Shift-click skips the dialog.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.strikeAttributeHint: The higher of the weapon's own Attribute (Might; Agility if Finesse or ranged) and the Key Attribute of a Combat Style you own whose weapon this is.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.supportHint: +1 Situation per other conscious ally whose Total Reach includes the target, to a maximum of +2. It does not add to Control: same type.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.rollHint: Roll a check in this Constellation.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.recoveryHint: Endure against 10 + Dying {value} + the Wounds you carry. Made at the start of each round; it costs no action.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.recoveryHelp: An adjacent ally spent ❶ to help: +2 Situation.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.refuseDeathText: {name} spends every Hero Point they have. It is not a roll: it cannot fail, and nothing in the game can stop it. They are unconscious and stable at 0 Vigor, their Wounds remain, and they have bought one more scene.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.windHint: From the end of the third round, and each round after: Endure against 10 + Load Strain, or be Fatigued (−1 Evade and Guard) until after the fight.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.treatWoundHint: Endure against 10 + the Wounds the patient carries. Ten minutes.
STARWROUGHT.Roll.unwieldyGrabbed: {name} is Grabbed and cannot attack with {weapon} at all: it is Unwieldy. The roll is posted anyway; the table decides.
STARWROUGHT.Rest.title: A night's rest
STARWROUGHT.Rest.text: {name} sleeps, and recovers {hp} Vigor (level × Presence, at least level). Wounds do not clear with rest.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.attributes: Attributes are never bought and never rolled. They are the Talents you own, counted: points ÷ 4, rounded down, maximum +5.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.originPool: The Origin Constellation has three Roots. Ancestry, Bloodline and Culture merge into one sky, and its Proficiency Rank counts all the points across its sources.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.parentConstellation: A child of {name}: every Talent bought here also counts toward {name}'s Proficiency Rank. Only rank is inherited.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.checks: d20 + Attribute Bonus + Proficiency Bonus + bonuses and penalties. Level never touches the die. A Threshold is 10 + the same modifier.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.materialWeakness: Against the damage type its material turns poorly, a piece's Protection is reduced by 1.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.matchedHarness: Matched harness: +1 Protection on the Torso, and 1 less Load Strain.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.clatter: Clatter: two or more mail or plate pieces while the torso is neither. You are Noisy whatever the individual pieces say.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.armor: Each Zone holds one piece, bought, worn, and lost separately. Your Torso is the number that matters most, because ordinary Hits land there.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.helm: A Closed helm is −2 Situation to Awareness checks, the Awareness Threshold and Initiative; an Open helm is −1.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.actions: Maneuvers and Activities this character has picked up: dragged from the compendium, made here, or copied down from the Basic Maneuvers above to make their own.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.sixActions: Six actions a round, received at the start of it and gone at the end. Each time the circuit reaches you is an Opportunity: one Maneuver you can afford, or Pass. Reactions ↺ between Opportunities spend from the same six.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.basicActions: What every character can do. Click a name to use it as this character: the card goes to chat, or the check it calls for is rolled. Shift-click skips the dialog. These are read from the Maneuvers compendium, so a rewrite there is a rewrite here.
STARWROUGHT.Sheet.noBasicActions: The Actions compendium holds no Basic Actions. Build it with node assets/build_foundry.mjs.
STARWROUGHT.Sheet.basicAdopt: Copy onto this sheet, as this character's own to edit.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.automation: What the system should do when this is used, as written in the Automation column of data/actions.xlsx. Notes for now: nothing acts on them yet.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.grazeCost: A Graze: one weapon die to a Zone the defender chooses, less Protection, never below 1. It never Wounds, and it does not Expose the defender.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.weaponTraits: Traits carry the rules. Agile (a Quick Strike may Critically Hit), Finesse, Parry (+1 Gear to Guard against melee Attacks), Flexible (cannot Parry, Bind or be Bound), Massive (any Critical Hit Wounds), Unparryable, Unwieldy 3, Deadly d8, Two-Hand d8, Thrown 20, Ranged 120, Mechanical (no Might), Armor-Piercing 1, Versatile P, and the rest are all read from the Trait line.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.npcThresholds: The players roll everything, so an adversary carries Thresholds rather than bonuses.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.attackThreshold: The number a player's Defense roll has to beat.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.movement: Speed is feet per Move ❶. Step ❶ is half of it and never provokes; Rush ❸ is five times it in a straight line, less Load Strain; Leap ❶ is 10 feet, less Load Strain, or 3 up.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.wounds: Two ways to be Wounded: a Critical Hit with a Deliberate or Committed Strike on an Exposed Zone, or any Hit while Spent. The Zone's critical effect made lasting.
STARWROUGHT.Prompt.deleteBody: {name} will be removed from this sheet. This cannot be undone.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.notDying: Not Dying. A Recovery check is only made while Dying.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.noHeroPoints: No Hero Points left to spend.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.noCombatant: This character is not in the current encounter.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.noActor: The Actor behind this card could not be found.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.notOwner: You do not own that character.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.noWeapon: That weapon is no longer on the sheet.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.noTarget: Select or target a token first.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.droppedToZero: Reduced to 0 Vigor: Spent. Every Hit now Wounds the Zone it strikes.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.spent: {name} is Spent: 0 Vigor. Every Hit now Wounds.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.roundEnds: Everyone has Passed. The round ends.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.preparedDue: {name} has a Prepared Maneuver: finish it or abandon it.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.cannotPassPreparing: {name} cannot Pass while Preparing: finish or abandon it.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.diagonals: This scene's grid does not measure diagonals exactly. STARWROUGHT measures them exactly: a diagonal step across a one-foot square costs about 1.4 feet, and a Move costs its true distance. Set the scene's diagonal rule to Exact.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.emptyPacks: STARWROUGHT: the compendium packs are empty. Run 'node tools/build-packs.mjs' in the system folder to compile the shipped content.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.staleAssets: Your browser is running a copy of STARWROUGHT ({stale}) that does not match the server's ({server}). Press Ctrl+F5 (Cmd+Shift+R on a Mac) to reload it. If this keeps happening, something between you and the server is caching Foundry's files; see the README.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.title: Character Creation
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.startTitle: This character has not been built yet
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.startBanner: Creation in STARWROUGHT is a sequence: your Ancestry decides which Bloodlines exist, and your Background decides where its points may go. The wizard walks it one step at a time.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.resumeBlurb: The wizard remembers where you were, and Back still unwinds the choices you made.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.cancelBody: Every choice this wizard made comes back off the character: the Talents it added are deleted and the fields it set are cleared. The character itself is kept.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.gotoHint: Go back to this step. Everything after it is unwound.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.incomplete: This step still has a choice to make or a Talent Point to spend.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.moreBelow: A point is still to spend below. Scroll down, or click here.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.pickConstellation: Choose where this point goes, then choose a Talent.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.autoSpent: Taken automatically: this was the only legal purchase. Becoming Trained in a Constellation you have not opened buys its Root, and there is nothing else the point could do. Use Back if you want to change the choice that granted it.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.stuck: There is nothing legal left for this point. It is set aside, and you may move on.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.name: Character name
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.doneText: {name} is finished: {ancestry}, {calling}, {vigor} Vigor, {talents} Talents (a 1st-level character has at least {minimum}).
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.training: STARWROUGHT is a heroic fantasy game: every character begins Trained in Melee or Ranged, your choice, before a single point is spent. Melee is rolled for anything in your hand; Ranged for anything that leaves it, a thrown dagger included. Every Combat Style is a child of one of them, and its Talents count toward the parent's rank as well.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.trainingFooter: Your next three choices grant more free Roots (your Ancestry, your Bloodline, your Culture) before you spend anything either; your Background then hands you three points to spend, on two Skills and a Lore of its own. The Defenses are not free: two Defense Talent Points come later, and you choose which two Defenses they open.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.trainingChildren: Children of {name}, whose Talents count toward its rank: {list}.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.trainingNoRoot: No Root Talent in the compendium
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.trainingMissing: The Talents compendium has no Root for {name}, so nothing was granted. Rebuild the compendium and choose again.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.trainingNone: Neither Melee Training nor Ranged Training is enabled in the spreadsheets, so no Weapon Training can be granted yet.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.nothingEnabled: Nothing is enabled for this step yet. The spreadsheets decide what ships to Foundry (Enabled? = Yes); continue without a pick.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.reachableFloor: {available} of the book's {minimum} Talents can be placed with what is enabled; the rest wait on the spreadsheets.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.nothingLeft: Nothing more is enabled in {name} for this point to buy. It is set aside until the spreadsheets enable more there.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.ancestry: The body your character was born in. It sets Vigor per level, Size, Speed (in feet per Move), and one special ability, and it forms the trunk of your Origin Constellation. Its Root Talent is granted free.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.bloodline: The lineage inside the Ancestry. Its Root Talent is granted free, and some Bloodlines hand you a Talent Point of their own to spend here.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.culture: Where you were raised, which is deliberately separate from what you were born as. Its Root grants a language and a Diplomacy bonus toward those who share it.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.background: What happened to you before the road. Your trade grants Training in two Skills and in a Lore of its own.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.calling: The life you chose. It grants Training in one Skill, Vigor per level, and a signature technique that sits at the Root of its Constellation. Only your first Calling ever counts toward Vigor.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.defenses: Two Defense Talent Points, and the choice of which two Defenses they open. Each Defense answers two of the four kinds of threat (Blows, Blasts, Blights, Beguilement) and each kind is answered by two Defenses, so two Trained Defenses cover three kinds: choose the pair whose gap you can live with. A Defense you leave Untrained still adds its Attribute, but every Threshold that depends on it is 3 lower.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.comets: A Comet is a Talent Point that answers to no Constellation. Spend it anywhere you qualify for, even a sky you have never touched.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.blurb.review: Name your character and finish. Everything here is already on the sheet: Vigor is 10 + Ancestry Vigor + Calling Vigor, each Attribute is its points ÷ 4, and every Constellation you own is Trained (+3). A completed 1st-level character has at least 14 Talent Points spent.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.coverageHint: Blows are answered by Evade or Guard, Blasts by Evade or Endure, Blights by Endure or Awareness, Beguilement by Awareness or Guard. A threat with neither of its Defenses Trained is the gap.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.countsToward: Counts toward {name} as well: a point here raises that rank too.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.countsTowardLocked: Counts toward {name} as well, once you own {name}'s Root: only rank is inherited, and buying the Root is what makes you Trained.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.trainedHint: Become Trained in it: if the Constellation is not open, this point buys its Root, and that purchase is what makes you Trained.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.loreHint: Every Lore is its own Constellation, so this one gets its own rank and grows on its own.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.callingHint: It buys your Calling's signature technique, which sits at its Root.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.callingSkillHint: Your Calling's free Training. If you are already Trained there, the point buys a deeper Talent instead of being wasted.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.defenseHint: Awareness, Evade, Guard, or Endure: each point opens a different Defense by buying its Training Root. If your Calling already Trained one of them, a point there buys a deeper Talent instead.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.cometHint: Three points, anywhere you qualify for. Identity Roots are the one thing a Comet can never buy: those come from your choices, not your points.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.grantHint: A Talent you just took hands you another point. It has to be spent before you move on.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.talentsShort: {n} short of the {floor} Talents that can be placed with what is enabled. A granted point went unspent, or a slot had nothing enabled left to buy.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.choicePrompt: {talent} asks you to choose: {prompt}. Without an answer the Talent has no mechanical effect, so pick now or fill it in on the Talent's own sheet later.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.choiceShared: {name} comes with it, free, and takes the same answer. You are only asked once.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.freeTalentGranted: {name} was granted free, with no Talent Point spent.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.freeTalentMissing: This Talent hands over "{name}", which is not in the Talents compendium.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.lorePrompt: Every Lore (X) is a copy of the same template, so name the field this one covers.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.lorePlaceholder: Circus, Warfare, the Underworld, Trade Roads
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.whyBloodlineRoot: A Bloodline Root is granted by choosing that Bloodline, never bought.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.whyIdentityRoot: Identity Roots come from your character-creation choices, never from points.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.whyNeedsRoot: Nothing here can be bought before {name}.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.whyTier: {tier} is locked: you do not have the points or the level for it yet.
STARWROUGHT.Chargen.whyCapstone: A capstone needs a Master Talent in this Constellation first.
STARWROUGHT.Flare.title: Flare
STARWROUGHT.Flare.hint: A Constellation Flares on a Critical Success or Critical Failure on a roll with consequences, directly related to a Talent in it.
STARWROUGHT.Flare.prompt: Which Constellation did that belong to? It needn't be one you have opened: a Milestone Talent Point spent there buys its Root.
STARWROUGHT.Flare.message: {name} is Flared. A Milestone Talent Point may be spent there, and it stays Flared until you do.
STARWROUGHT.Carry.drawHint: Draw it. One Interact action in an encounter.
STARWROUGHT.Carry.stowHint: Put it away. One Interact action in an encounter.
STARWROUGHT.Carry.wearHint: Put it on. A minute for each point of Protection, so not during a fight.
STARWROUGHT.Carry.takeOffHint: Take it off. It goes into your gear.
STARWROUGHT.Carry.donTimeHint: Putting this piece on or taking it off takes 1 minute for each point of Protection.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.label: Actions
STARWROUGHT.Actions.resetHint: Back to six actions. The reserve is emptied and any Prepared Maneuver is cleared.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.yourTurn: Your Opportunity: {left} of {total} actions left this round.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.notYourTurn: Not your Opportunity. Reactions are paid from the same six actions, on anyone's.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.expired: Unspent actions expire at the end of the round.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.leftReserved: {left} of {per} actions left this round, {reserved} reserved.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.overActions: {name} did {what}, which costs {need}, with only {left} action(s) left this round: {over} over.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.overNote: It happened anyway. The system counts; the table decides.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.notHeld: {name} is not in hand. Draw it first.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.armorInCombat: Putting on or taking off {name} takes about {minutes} minute(s). That is not something you do in the middle of an encounter.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.moveHint: ❶ Move up to your Speed. Entering a foe's Total Reach from outside may provoke an Intercept.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.stepHint: ❶ Up to half your Speed. It never provokes, cannot enter difficult terrain, and ends any Bind you are in (Close excepted).
STARWROUGHT.Actions.stepText: {name} Steps {feet} feet: 1 action, and nothing is provoked.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.rushHint: ❸ Up to five times your Speed in a straight line, less Load Strain in feet. No Reactions until your next Opportunity, and Off-Guard against any Intercept made during it.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.rushText: {name} Rushes {feet} feet: 3 actions, no Reactions until their next Opportunity, and Off-Guard to any Intercept on the way.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.passHint: Decline this Opportunity. Pass is not a Maneuver; a full circuit of Passes ends the round. You may still React, and act again if someone else keeps the round going.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.endOpportunityHint: Your Maneuver is done: play moves to the next combatant.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.reserved: {n} reserved for a Prepared Maneuver. Finish it at your next Opportunity, or abandon it and the reserve returns.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.reservedHint: {n} action(s) held for a Prepared Maneuver. They return if it is abandoned.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.preparingText: {name} begins {what}: 1 action now, {reserved} reserved. It resolves at their next Opportunity.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.preparingHint: A Maneuver of three or more actions: one spent, the rest reserved. At your next Opportunity you must finish it or abandon it; you cannot Pass while Preparing. Taking a Wound abandons it.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.finishHint: Spend the reserved actions and resolve the Prepared Maneuver. Range, line of effect and requirements are checked again.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.abandonHint: Give it up. The action already spent is lost; the reserved actions return to your pool.
STARWROUGHT.Hint.armorInCombat: An encounter is running. Armor takes minutes to put on or take off, so it is locked until the fight ends.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.trackActionsHint: Spend actions automatically for Strikes, Reactions, Raise a Shield, Recenter, drawing or stowing a weapon, and movement (one action per Move, a Step, or a Rush). Only ever applies during an encounter, and the pips on the sheet can always be corrected by hand.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.showReach: Show Total Reach on the map
STARWROUGHT.Settings.showReachHint: Draw a ring at your Total Reach around the token you control or hover over. Natural Reach plus the longest melee weapon in hand.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.showTargetArrows: Draw targeting arrows on the map
STARWROUGHT.Settings.showTargetArrowsHin: An arrow from each token to whatever it is targeting, in the targeting player's colour, visible to everyone who can see both tokens. Targets are remembered on the token, so they survive a reload and are listed in the Combat Tracker.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.label: Answering with
STARWROUGHT.Stance.hint: How the next Blow is answered. The defender chooses: Evade (do not be there), Guard (do not let it through), or a Reaction paid ❶ from the same six actions when the attack lands: Void (Evade +2), Parry (Guard +2, needs a rigid weapon or shield in hand), or Counter (your basic Defense, and a Quick Strike back). Switch any time before the attacker rolls; the attack reads it.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.hudTooltip: Answering with {current} ({threshold}). Click to answer with {next}.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.dialogHint: The defender chooses how to answer, and the roll meets whatever they have chosen by the time the die is thrown. The Defense, any Reaction, and the Threshold appear on the card; a Reaction is charged to the defender when the roll resolves.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.hidden: The defender's stance, revealed on the card
STARWROUGHT.Stance.switchToUnavailable: Answer with {defense}. Unavailable while {reason}; the table decides.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.unavailableNote: That Defense is unavailable while {reason}. Nothing is prevented; the table decides.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.reactionCost: Costs ❶ when the attack lands, then falls back to the basic Defense.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.spent: {name}'s {reaction} answers the attack: ❶ spent, back to {defense}.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.autoOpenHint: When a Talent arrives on a character with no Constellation Item for it, fetch the Constellation from the compendium so the sky is drawn.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.offerFlares: Offer a Flare on a critical
STARWROUGHT.Settings.offerFlaresHint: Put a Flare button on the chat card whenever a roll criticals, so the Constellation can be lit from the table.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.autoRecoveryHint: Notify the owner at the start of each round while a character is Dying: that is when the Recovery check is made.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.passFailed: The Pass could not be recorded. See the console.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.passWhilePreparing: {name} Passes while Preparing {label}. The handbook says you cannot: finish it or abandon it at this Opportunity.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.recoveryText: Round {round}: {name} is Dying {dying} and carries {wounds} Wound(s). Endure against {threshold}; it costs no action.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.recoveryOutcomes: Critical success: Dying ends, conscious with 1 Vigor. Success: Dying drops by 1 (at 0, stable but unconscious). Failure: Dying rises by 1. Critical failure: by 2.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.recoveryHelp: An adjacent ally may spend ❶ for a +2 Situation bonus to this check.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.windText: End of round {round}: {name} carries Load Strain {strain}. Endure against {threshold}, or be Fatigued (-1 Evade and Guard) until after the fight.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.windNote: From the end of the third round and every round after, for anyone with Load Strain 1 or more. Men in harness fought hard for a minute, not ten.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.windFatigued: {name} is winded: Fatigued, -1 to Evade and Guard until they catch their breath after the fight.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.persistentText: End of round {round}: {name} takes {formula} persistent {type}. Roll it fresh; Protection does not apply.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.persistentNote: Immediately after taking it, Endure against 10 + the amount to end it. An adjacent ally may spend ❶ for +2 Situation. It keeps working while unconscious and while Dying.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.persistentWoundNote: From a Torso Wound, which does not clear until the Wound is treated: it bleeds every round the Wound stands, and no Endure check closes it.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.persistentTaken: {name} takes {total} persistent {type}. Protection does not apply.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.persistentApplyNote: Apply it on the sheet: the damage pipeline is built around a Zone and its Protection, and this has neither.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.preparedText: Round {round}: {name} is Preparing {label} ({cost} actions: 1 spent, {reserved} reserved). Finish it now, spending the reserve, or abandon it: the action spent is lost and the reserve returns.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.preparedNote: Check range, line of effect and requirements again before finishing. A Prepared blow follows its target only while the target stays in Reach; a Prepared area stays where it was marked. You cannot Pass while Preparing.
STARWROUGHT.Combat.preparedNoMethod: This build cannot finish or abandon a Prepared Maneuver from the card yet. Use the sheet.
STARWROUGHT.Tracker.pass: Pass ⓿: decline this Opportunity. A full circuit of Passes ends the round.
STARWROUGHT.Tracker.passStreakHint: Passes in a row this round, out of the combatants who get an Opportunity. When everyone Passes in one circuit, the round ends.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.stepNote: A Step never provokes an Intercept, and cannot enter difficult terrain.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.moveText: {name} covers {feet} feet on a Speed of {speed}: {moves} Move(s), {cost} action(s).
STARWROUGHT.Actions.moveChainNote: Each Move is its own Maneuver, and one Opportunity holds one Maneuver: this is more than one Opportunity's worth. The system counts; the table decides.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.rushInsteadNote: A straight line this long would be a Rush ❸ (up to {rush} ft) for three actions.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.rushNote: No Reactions until the next Opportunity, and Off-Guard against any Intercept made during the Rush. A Rush always provokes.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.crawlText: {name} crawls {feet} feet, {crawl} feet per action: {cost} action(s).
STARWROUGHT.Actions.crawlNote: Prone and unable to Stand: Crawl ❶ moves 3 feet. A Crawl never provokes an Intercept.
STARWROUGHT.Migration.speed: STARWROUGHT {version}: {count} stored Speed value(s) on the old five-foot scale were brought to feet per Move (25 becomes 6). Speed is stored as typed from here on.
STARWROUGHT.Migration.stance: STARWROUGHT {version}: {count} character(s) held a Reaction stance they no longer qualify for (Counter now needs Expert rank in Melee) and now answer with the basic Defense instead.
STARWROUGHT.Migration.exposed: STARWROUGHT {version}: Exposed Zones now show on the token as statuses. {exposed} status(es) were set from Zones already open, and {normalised} condition effect(s) were brought under the ids the token palette uses, twins removed.
STARWROUGHT.Intercept.moveText: {mover} Moves from outside {foe}'s Total Reach ({reach} ft) to inside it. {foe} may Intercept ❶↺: a Quick Strike at the moment they enter.
STARWROUGHT.Intercept.rushText: {mover} Rushes into {foe}'s Total Reach ({reach} ft). {foe} may Intercept ❶↺: a Quick Strike at the moment they enter.
STARWROUGHT.Intercept.note: Once per foe per Move. A Wound stops the movement; anything less and it continues. A Reaction never triggers a Reaction.
STARWROUGHT.Intercept.rushNote: A Rush always provokes, and {mover} is Off-Guard against the Intercept.
STARWROUGHT.Intercept.noWeapon: No melee weapon in hand: the Intercept is an unarmed Quick Strike, rolled by hand.
STARWROUGHT.Intercept.noAttack: This adversary has no attack recorded, so there is no Threshold to answer. The table decides.
STARWROUGHT.Intercept.quickStrikeNote: A Quick Strike: one weapon die plus precision, on the Torso; it cannot Critically Hit unless the weapon is Agile, and Protection applies in full.
STARWROUGHT.Intercept.answerText: {foe} Intercepts {mover} with {attack} (Attack Threshold {threshold}). {mover} answers with a Defense roll.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.showMoveBands: Colour the drag ruler by Moves
STARWROUGHT.Settings.showMoveBandsHint: While dragging a token, colour the highlighted squares by which action pays for them: pale mint within a Step, then one colour per Move (gold first, six in all), orange for a straight Rush, red for anything past what you have left to spend. Nothing is prevented; the red squares are a warning.
STARWROUGHT.Field.spentHint: Spent: at 0 Vigor. You are still standing, but every Hit now Wounds the Zone it strikes, a Critical Hit twice. A Graze never Wounds.
STARWROUGHT.Field.woundCountHint: Wounds carried across every Zone. Each one raises the Threshold of a Recovery check and of treating another Wound.
STARWROUGHT.Field.specializationHint: Extra damage on a full Strike from your Melee and Ranged ranks: +2 Expert, +3 Master, +4 Legendary.
STARWROUGHT.Field.trainingHint: Which Proficiency this weapon rolls, after Handling and Familiarity.
STARWROUGHT.Field.damageHint: A Deliberate or Committed Hit. A Quick Strike or a Graze rolls one die ({quick}), less Protection.
STARWROUGHT.Strike.attributeFromStyle: Strike Attribute: {attribute}, the Key Attribute of {style}. You own its root and are wielding its weapon, and it beats the weapon's own.
STARWROUGHT.Wound.add: Add a Wound to this Zone. Everything a Wound does still happens: a Prepared Maneuver is abandoned, a Torso Wound bleeds, a final Torso or Head Wound is Dying.
STARWROUGHT.Wound.remove: Take a Wound off this Zone. Bookkeeping only; no check is rolled.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.needsVoid: Void ❶↺ needs Evade Training: Evade with a +2 Situation bonus, and Step if the attack is Stopped.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.needsParry: Parry ❶↺ needs Guard Training and a rigid weapon or shield in hand: Guard with a +2 Situation bonus, and Control of a Deliberate or Committed Strike you Stop.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.needsCounter: Counter ❶↺ needs Expert rank in Melee (Melee Training grants Intercept alone): answer a melee Blow within your Reach with a Quick Strike of your own.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.switchToReaction: Answer with {stance}: {defense} {bonus} Situation. Costs ❶ when the attack lands on you.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.switchToCounter: Answer with Counter: your basic Defense, no bonus, and a Quick Strike back at a melee Blow within your Reach. Both resolve. Costs ❶ when the attack lands on you.
STARWROUGHT.Stance.hudTooltipOnly: Answering with {current} ({threshold}). Nothing else to switch to.
STARWROUGHT.Actions.perRoundHint: Six for most creatures, received at the start of each round. An Elite or Boss template may give more.
STARWROUGHT.Rest.hint: A full night's rest restores level × Presence Vigor, or your level if Presence is 1 or less. Wounds are untouched.
STARWROUGHT.Strike.preparedTag: Prepared: resolves at your next Opportunity
STARWROUGHT.Strike.outOfReach: Out of reach: the target is {gap} ft away and this weapon reaches {reach} ft. The Strike was rolled anyway; the table decides.
STARWROUGHT.Strike.outOfRange: Out of range: the target is {gap} ft away and this weapon carries {range} ft. The Strike was rolled anyway; the table decides.
STARWROUGHT.Strike.dialogHint: The count of actions is how much of yourself is behind the blow. Quick ❶ probes with one die; Deliberate ❷ swings with everything; Committed ❸ is Prepared and lands at your next Opportunity.
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.blocked: {name} cannot use Reactions right now; the basic Defense answers.
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.counterNeedsMelee: Counter answers only a melee Blow from a foe within your Reach; the basic Defense answers, nothing is spent, and the stance stands.
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.basicOnly: A Reaction never triggers a Reaction: the basic Defense answers, with nothing behind it and nothing spent.
STARWROUGHT.Bind.cannotBind: {weapon} offers nothing to bind: only a melee weapon or natural attack that is neither Flexible nor Unparryable can be Bound.
STARWROUGHT.Reaction.noWeapon: {name} has no weapon in hand to Strike back with.
STARWROUGHT.Position.title: Position
STARWROUGHT.Position.stepText: {name} may Step up to {feet} ft, in any direction. It costs nothing and provokes nothing.
STARWROUGHT.Position.gaveGround: {name} gives {feet} ft of ground, directly away from the attacker.
STARWROUGHT.Position.exposedText: {name} is Exposed in the {zone}, until they Recenter.
STARWROUGHT.Position.notOwnedExpose: {name} belongs to someone else; their owner marks the Zone Exposed.
STARWROUGHT.Bind.partnerNotOwned: {partner} belongs to someone else; their side of the Bind is written by their owner's client, or the GM's, as this reaches it.
STARWROUGHT.Bind.exposePrompt: You Control the weapon. Which Zone on {partner} is Exposed while the Bind lasts?
STARWROUGHT.Wound.bleed: Persistent bleed (end of each round; Protection does not apply)
STARWROUGHT.Wound.dyingFrom: The {zone} has taken its final Wound: Dying {value}.
STARWROUGHT.Wound.reasonExposed: A Critical Hit on an Exposed Zone with a Deliberate or Committed Strike
STARWROUGHT.Prepared.title: Prepared
STARWROUGHT.Prepared.begun: {name} begins {what}: one action spent, {reserved} reserved. It resolves at their next Opportunity, or is abandoned.
STARWROUGHT.Prepared.abandoned: {name} abandons {what}. The action already spent is lost; {returned} reserved action(s) return.
STARWROUGHT.Prepared.abandonedReplaced: {name} sets aside {what} to prepare something else. The action already spent is lost.
STARWROUGHT.Prepared.expired: The round ended with {name} still Preparing {what}. The reserved actions expired with it.
STARWROUGHT.Prepared.outsideEncounter: Preparing a Maneuver means something only in an encounter. Outside one, it simply happens.
STARWROUGHT.Prepared.cannotPass: {name} cannot Pass while Preparing. Finish it or abandon it first.
STARWROUGHT.Action.recenterPosture: A Zone Exposed by a Posture stays open until the end of the round.
STARWROUGHT.Notify.noToken: No token on the scene to move.
STARWROUGHT.Damage.zoneDefender: A Graze lands where the defender says it skated.
STARWROUGHT.Damage.zoneAttacker: A Critical Hit lands where the attacker chooses.
STARWROUGHT.Damage.zoneExposedChoice: A Hit lands on the Torso, or on an Exposed Zone of the attacker's choice.
STARWROUGHT.Damage.zoneTorso: A Hit lands on the Torso. No Zone is Exposed.
STARWROUGHT.Damage.zoneQuick: A Quick Strike lands on the Torso, and meets its Protection in full.
STARWROUGHT.Damage.grazeNote: One weapon die, less Protection, minimum 1. No Wound, whatever the defender's state. Position is settled on the attack card.
STARWROUGHT.Damage.massiveNote: Massive: this Critical Hit Wounds the Zone it lands on, Exposed or not.
STARWROUGHT.Damage.spentNow: Spent. From here every Hit Wounds the Zone it strikes; a Critical Hit twice.
STARWROUGHT.Damage.spentAlready: Spent: a Hit Wounds the Zone struck.
STARWROUGHT.Damage.knockedOut: Nonlethal: knocked unconscious instead of Wounded. Wakes in ten minutes with 1 Vigor.
STARWROUGHT.Attack.title: Attack
STARWROUGHT.Attack.missing: That attack is no longer live.
STARWROUGHT.Attack.wrongPhase: That attack is not at that step.
STARWROUGHT.Attack.badRoll: That roll could not be read.
STARWROUGHT.Attack.failed: The attack could not be updated; see the console.
STARWROUGHT.Attack.autoStance: {name} answers with its standing stance (no GM is connected).
STARWROUGHT.Attack.resolveFailed: {name}: the pairing did not resolve; see the console.
STARWROUGHT.Attack.reset: Defenses reset by the GM: choose again
STARWROUGHT.Attack.stale: That attack has moved on; this choice no longer applies.
STARWROUGHT.Attack.notYours: That decision belongs to another player.
STARWROUGHT.Attack.noTargets: No target: the Strike rolls at once.

STARWROUGHT.Attack.timeout: The coordinator did not answer in time; try again.
STARWROUGHT.Attack.usedStances: Uncommitted defenders answered with their standing stances
STARWROUGHT.Prompt.title: Combat
STARWROUGHT.Prompt.reopen: Reopen from the attack card in chat
STARWROUGHT.Prompt.headWound: A Head Wound: no Reactions, the basic Defense alone
STARWROUGHT.Prompt.counterNeedsMelee: Counter answers a melee Blow within Reach only
STARWROUGHT.Prompt.postureHint: A Posture costs nothing and Exposes the Zone you name until the end of the round, whether or not it works.
STARWROUGHT.Prompt.stanceHint: Pre-set from the standing stance. The choice is for this Blow alone; the stance itself does not change.
STARWROUGHT.Prompt.keysHint: Enter commits; Escape closes the window.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.attackFlowHint: A Strike at a target declares first: defenders commit a Defense and an answer in private, all reveal at once, then the player rolls. Off, a character's Strike rolls at once as before; an adversary's attack row always declares, since adversaries do not roll.
STARWROUGHT.Settings.attackShowPcThresho: Show a character's Threshold to the attacker

After the defenses reveal, the attacking player sees the defending character's Threshold on the attack card. Off, only the defender and the GM see it. Inside the flow an adversary's Thresholds are never shown to players.
